properties.name: Arlington Lakes
properties.directions: If travelling from Kelowna the Arlington Lakes turnoff is approx. 24 km south of the Big White turnoff. If travelling from the south the turnoff is approx. 24 km north of Beaverdell along Highway 33. Upon leaving the highway travel along the Arlington Lakes Forest Service Road for approx. 3.5 km to the recreation site.

properties.name: Canyon Lakes Cabin
properties.directions: Winter access directions can be found on McCulloch Snowmobile Trails.

properties.name: Red Bridge
properties.directions: West of Keremeos, turn south on Ashnola Road and cross the Red Bridge across the Similkameen River. Travel 10.3 km to Red Bridge Recreation Site on the east side of the road.

properties.name: Tunnel
properties.directions: Access is from Hwy 3 (Crowsnest) just west of Keremeos. Turn south on Ashnola Road, cross over the Similkameen River via the "Red Bridge". The road follows the south side of the Similkameen for several kilometers before it turns south along the Ashnola River. This Recreation Site is approximately 13.8 km from Hwy 3.

properties.name: Horseshoe Canyon
properties.directions: Access is from Hwy 3 (Crowsnest)just west of Keremeos. Turn south on Ashnola Road, cross over the Similkameen River via the "Red Bridge". The road follows the south side of the Similkameen for several kilometers before it turns south along the Ashnola River. This Recreation Site is approximately 15 km from Hwy 3.

properties.name: Ashnola River
properties.directions: Drive west from Keremeos approximately 4 km and turn left (South) on Ashnola Road. Cross the Similkameen River via the Red Bridge. This Recreation Site is appoximately 18km from the highway.

properties.name: Nickel Plate X/C Ski Trails
properties.directions: +/- 45 min. drive West of Penticton BC on Green Mountian Road , onto Apex Mountain Road or from Keremeos heading North on HWY 3A onto Green Mountain Road and onto Apex Mountain Road.

properties.name: Okanagan Falls Trails
properties.directions: Driving from Hwy 97 at Okanagan Falls turn East onto 10th Ave and then onto Mclean Creek Road and onto Allendale Lake Road the total distance is about +/- 6.0 km. Allendale Lake Road is in rough condition.

properties.name: Old Hedley Road East
properties.activities: Nature Study, Beach Activities, Swimming & Bathing
properties.directions: Located off Highway 3, 31 Km east of Princeton or 7 Km west of Hedley on the Old Hedley Road.

properties.name: Pickard Creek
properties.directions: Located approximately 6 km west of Hedley (32KM east of Princeton) along Highway 3. Access is on the left hand side, when driving westward, just before the Sterling Bridge. Located between Highway 3 and the Similkameen River.

properties.name: Chute Lake
properties.activities: Hunting, Trail Bike Riding - Motorized, Camping
properties.directions: Take Hwy 97 to Penticton to Naramata Road to Chute Lake Road. The road is paved for 2.5 kms and then turns to gravel on the forest service road. Drive 10.4 kms up Chute Lake Forest Service Road, drive through the Chute Lake Lodge for 300m to access the Kettle Valley Trail. At the stop sign, turn right onto the Kettle Valley Trail. After 200m o the KVR, turn left onto Elinor Lake Forest Service Road. After another 150m, turn left into the access for Chute Lake Rec Site. The access road is 150m to the lake, and is in rough condition.

properties.name: Trout Creek Crossing
properties.closure: The Recreation Site is closed due to an active wildfire in the area. The area is currently under Evacuation Order. Find further information at BC Wildfire Service .
properties.directions: West of Summer land on the Princeton Summerland Road. 49.647877? -119.927058. From Faulder, located 13 km up the Princeton Summerland Road (8 km unpaved gravel)

properties.name: Isintok Lake
properties.closure: The Recreation Site is closed due to an active wildfire in the area. Primary access route travels through burnt area of Bald Range Fire.
properties.directions: Follow Hwy 97 to Summerland, On Bathville Road, McNulty Forest Service Road starts just beyond the Kettle Valley Steam Train. Once on McNulty FSR, travel 22.5km to the left turn off to Isintok Lake and drive 750m to the location of the campsites. This access road is quite narrow with little room to pass oncoming traffic.

properties.name: Burnell Lake
properties.directions: Off Hwy 97, turn west onto Fairview Road. Follow for 4.2km and turn north onto Willowbrook Road. Follow Willowbrook for 3.9kms and turn left onto Sawmill Burnell Lake gravel road. Drive 4km up the hill to the lake. Road is dusty and rough with blind corners. Use caution.

properties.name: Madden Lake
properties.directions: From Oliver head West onto Fairview Rd. Follow Fairview Rd. for 11.3km and turn right. Drive for an additional 0.3km and turn right at the fork. Drive for 1.5km until you arrive at the Recreation Site.

properties.name: Allendale Lake
properties.closure: Allendale Lake will be closed until further notice due to dam removal and restoration work.
properties.directions: Follow Hwy 97 to Okanagan Falls to the 201 Forest Service Road. At Kilometer marker 18 on the 201 FSR, turn north onto Allendale Rd and follow the main road 6.1 km. The Recreation Site access will be to the right and 300m down to the lake.

properties.name: Ripley Lake
properties.directions: From Oliver, turn West onto Fairview Rd. Drive on Fairview Rd. for 11.3km and turn right. Drive for an additional 0.3km and turn left at the fork. Follow for 2km until you arrive at the Recreation Site.

properties.name: Nickel Plate Lake
properties.directions: From Pentiction turn West onto Green Mountain rd, drive 34 km to Apex Mt Resort, 1 km beyond the resort turns into gravel road (marker 13)Nickel plate Nordic is at 6.5 km past Apex. at mile marker 20 ( 7.8 km past apex ) turn right. travel 0.7 km to site ( rough road ) Access by four-wheel drive vehicles only as the last section of the road is very rough.

properties.name: ELINOR LAKE Elinor Lake
properties.directions: Access is via the Chute Lake FSR then the Elinor FSR. FWD Only.

properties.name: Thirsk Lake
properties.directions: Located up Hwy 40 aka the Princeton-Summerland Road.

properties.name: Idleback Lake
properties.directions: From Penticton, Carmi Road, take Ellis FSR 13.5 km to the 201 FSR. Turn left onto the 201, and drive 6.5 km and turn left into Idleback Recreation Site. From Hwy 33, turn south on the 201 FSR and drive south 36.2 km to the Recreation Site.

properties.name: Solco Lake
properties.directions: From Okanagan Falls at Highway 97, turn east onto Weyerhauser Road and drive 1km. Stay right on Weyerhauser Road. Travel 1.5 km until the 201 (Okanagan Falls Forest Service Road) FSR starts. Drive to km 12.3, and turn right onto the 200 (Venner Meadows Forest Service Road) FSR. Drive 11.6km (mile marker 24.5) and turn left onto Fish Forest Service Road. Travel another 11km (34.5 mile marker) to Solco Lake.

properties.name: Crump
properties.closure: The Recreation Site remains closed for wildfire recovery activities (for example, danger tree assessing and falling, area assessments, etc.) and to prevent negative impacts to ecosystems and wildlife.
properties.directions: From Summerland take the Prarie Valley Road and then the Princeton-Summerland Road to Crump Recreation Site and take a narrow 4WD road south down to KVR. Or, from Faulder, access using the KVR.

properties.name: Smethurst Staging Area
properties.directions: From Penticton, drive towards Naramata along Naramata Road. Continue past Naramata until you reach the Smethurst Road intersection. Turn onto Smethurst road and drive for 3.6 km (continue past the KVR non motorized parking area).

properties.name: Trout Creek
properties.closure: The Recreation Site remains closed for wildfire recovery activities (for example, danger tree assessing and falling, area assessments, etc.) and to prevent negative impacts to ecosystems and wildlife.
properties.directions: From Summerland take the Prairie Valley Road and then the Princeton-Summerland Road. 2.7 km of gravel road to Crump.

properties.name: Oliver Mountain
properties.directions: Access is via Willowbrook Rd approximately 2 km north of the Willowbrook/Fairview Rd. junction. There is a cattle fence, so ensure that the gate is closed behind you when you come and go.

properties.name: Agur Lake
properties.closure: The Recreation Site remains closed for wildfire recovery activities (for example, danger tree assessing and falling, area assessments, etc.) and to prevent negative impacts to ecosystems and wildlife.
properties.directions: Heading West from Summerland on Bathville Road, cross the railway tracks at the Kettle Valley Steam Railway, and travel 12.6 km up the McNulty Forest Service Rd. Turn left onto Agur Lake Forest Service Road (labelled Liddel FSR) for 3.3 km to the site access road turning right off Liddel FSR another 300m. This last 300m is 4WD reccommended.

properties.name: Carmi
properties.directions: Head east on Carmi Avenue in Penticton. Drive 6.2 km up Carmi Avenue, and then turn right onto Beaver Dell Road. Drive another 2.3 km to the main parking lot (also known as the Garnet Fire Interpretive Site), which boasts an outhouse, information kiosk and two picnic tables. Fires and overnight camping are prohibited at this parking lot. There is additional parking and access to trails 4 km up Ellis Forest Service Road.

properties.name: MCKINNEY CROSS COUNTRY SKI AREA
properties.directions: Travel Time: +/-30 minutes. From Oliver turn onto McKinney Rd and follow for 27kms. Destination will be on the right.

properties.name: Three Blind Mice
properties.activities: Other (see Note attached to File), Hiking, Mountain Biking
properties.directions: +/- 20-30 min from the center of Penticton BC and near Naramata BC. Take Naramata Road out of Penticton, and turn right onto Arawana Road. Turn left onto Arawana Forest Service Road, and drive an additional 5 km to the Rusty Muffler Parking Area.

properties.name: Okanagan Falls OHV Trails
properties.activities: Snowshoeing, Viewing, Trail Bike Riding - Motorized
properties.directions: Driving from Hwy 97 at Okanagan Falls turn East onto 10th Ave and then onto Mclean Creek Road and onto Allendale Lake Road the total distance is about +/- 6.0 km. Allendale Lake Road is in rough condition.

properties.name: Nickel Plate Cross Country Ski Trails
properties.directions: +/- 45 min. drive West of Penticton BC on Green Mountian Road , onto Apex Mountain Road or from Keremeos heading North on HWY 3A onto Green Mountain Road and onto Apex Mountain Road.

properties.name: Gladstone
properties.directions: Access is off Hwy 97 onto Princeton Ave and onto Somerset Ave and onto Gladstone Road and onto Victoria Street and Harrington Road , with a parking area near the base of the hill side.

properties.name: Nickel Plate Nordic Snowshoe Trails
properties.directions: +/- 45 min. drive West of Penticton BC on Green Mountian Road , onto Apex Mountain Road or from Keremeos heading North on HWY 3A onto Green Mountain Road and onto Apex Mountain Road.

properties.name: Oliver Mountain Trails
properties.directions: Access is via Willowbrook Rd. approximately 2 km north of the Willowbrook/Fairview Rd. junction. There is a cattle fence, so ensure that the gate is closed behind you when you come and go.

properties.name: Shatford Creek
properties.directions: Travel Time: +/-30 minutes from Penticton

properties.name: Brent Mountain Trail
properties.directions: Travel Time: +/-30 minutes from Penticton

properties.name: Okanagan Vista
properties.directions: Travel Time: +/-45 minutes from Penticton.

properties.name: Highland
properties.activities: Ski Touring, Mountain Biking, Horseback Riding, Snowshoeing, Viewing, Hiking
properties.directions: Travel Time: +/-20 minutes from Kelowna. Drive on Hwy 33 south until you reach Philpott Rd. This is where the most southern trailhead is located.
